description: Standard animation library and the gameplay/animation timing contract. Clip ids are the Blender action names and the Godot animation names. A character-specific version of a clip is named '{clip}__{character}' (e.g. 'victory__sara') and is selected through character.json animation.overrides.

events.windup: Anticipation begins (weight shifts against the coming action).
events.commit: Anticipation ends; acceleration starts. Last frame where the action can still be cancelled.
events.contact: Ball contact. Gameplay syncs to this event.
events.toss: Ball leaves the hand on a serve toss.
events.recover: Earliest frame gameplay may blend into the next clip.

timing_contract.note: Gameplay decides WHEN the ball is touched; animation decides HOW. SpikeCharacterActor.play_synced(clip, 'contact', seconds) scales playback so the event lands exactly on the gameplay time, within [min_speed, max_speed]. Outside that range, gameplay must choose a different clip (e.g. a quick attack instead of a full spike).
timing_contract.warp: When personality anticipation_hold != 1 or release_snap != 1, playback time is remapped piecewise between 'windup', 'commit' and 'contact' so the character keeps its rhythm while still hitting the sync time.

clips.desc: Relaxed between rallies. Personality lives here: weight shifts, hand habits, hair touches. Minimum 3 s before it repeats.
Additive chest/shoulder breathing layered on every stance. Faster and deeper after rallies (driven by an exertion parameter).
Receive-ready: knees bent, weight on the balls of the feet, arms forward. Small bounces.
Lateral defensive shuffle.
Sudden direction change: plant, drop the hips, head leads the turn.
Three-step spike approach (right-handed: R-L-R... ending with a double plant). Arms swing back on the penultimate step.
Standing jump (block/set). Deep load, explosive extension.
Holdable airborne pose for variable hang time.
Two-foot landing: absorb through ankles, knees, hips. Hair and hem keep falling after the body stops.
Forearm pass (bump). Platform set early, legs do the work, shoulders shrug toward the target.
Emergency dive dig with a slide recovery.
Overhead set. Hands form the window above the forehead before the ball arrives; soft wrists.
Standing float serve.
Jump serve with approach.
Airborne attack from takeoff to pre-landing. Bow-and-arrow load: non-hitting arm aims, hitting arm draws back, torso arches; then whip: hips, torso, shoulder, elbow, wrist in sequence.
Penetrating block: hands reach over the net, fingers spread and firm, shoulders shrug to the ears.
Ball-to-body flinch. Additive-friendly.
Point won. Must be character-specific at S and above.
Match won, results screen. Character-specific at all tiers.
Match lost.
Short frustration/reset beat.
Character-select entrance into the identity pose.
Menu idle with occasional personality actions.
Generated range-of-motion test (pipeline/blender/spike_pipeline/rom.py). Never shipped.

poses.note: Single-frame poses used for QC renders and presentation. Stored as actions named 'pose_{id}' with one key on frame 1.
poses.spike_contact: Frame from spike at the contact event.
poses.keyart: The character's identity pose, matched to the 2D key art (pose_keyart__{character}).

personality_params.note: The GLOBAL MOVEMENT LANGUAGE is the clip library. The CHARACTER PERSONALITY is these parameters (runtime) plus the character's overridden clips (authored). Defaults are 1.0 = the roster average.

tempo.runtime: global playback multiplier for locomotion and stance clips

overshoot.runtime: spring overshoot on secondary chains and procedural settles

idle_energy.runtime: idle variant weights and breathing depth
